descriptions.w3d_d32k_button_text_setup_8025f54c: Initialises the inner panel, copies the info flags, then for a non-empty label tries to load it as a named sprite. On failure it drops any old object, looks the label up in the text table (or builds a marked-up fallback), loads FE.Font, attaches, sizes and colours the text object. On success it attaches and positions the sprite. Finishes with the shared sprite setup and refresh.
